product_metadata.title: CSK Nonstick Frying Pan Set - 8'' + 11'' Fry Pan Set with Lids, Aluminum Alloy Granite Skillets, Superior Heat Transfer, All Stoves Compatible, Stainless Steel Ergonomic Handle APEO and PFOA-Free
features: [Stone-Derived Coating & Super Nonstick]: KOCH SYSTEME CS 8'' +11'' nonstick frying pan set utilize German-designed stone-derived coating, free of APEO and PFOA. Unlike traditional skillets, this fry pan sets with healthy coatings also allows you to cook your meals with less oil or butter.

[Precision Heat Distribution & Quick heat]: Provided with the heat conduction base, the 8'' & 11'' stone earth fry pans are made of forged aluminum alloy, with precise temperature control, food would be heat quickly. Oven safe up to 450°F!

[Stainless Steel Handle& Visible Lids]: The stainless steel handle of this stir-fry pans with ergonomic design, and the riveted stainless-steel handle is solid and durable, easily grip and maneuver the pan when cooking. You will feel the nice touch of it in your daily cooking.

[Great Quality & Very easy to clean]: The frying pans set is anti-warping and scratch-resistant that enhances both durability and usage experience. Whether it's an egg, steak, or muffin, it's easy to clean and you can say goodbye to the annoying burning food which sticking to the pans.

[All Four Stoves Compatible & All in One Set]: The 8'' and 11'' fry pans with the multi-layer composited bottom is heat & magnetic conductive, available for daily use on stovetops – induction, electric, gas, and ceramic. Only one set frying pans can meet all your different needs.
